results.details: Fifty-two ordered route rules uniquely cover 326/326 public operations with zero unmatched or equal-priority conflicts; all 51 internal operations are denied at the external boundary, and the canonical projection exactly matches the Gateway fragment.

Learner Web, Admin Web, Mobile H5, Official Site and native Bearer profiles have distinct capabilities; credentialed CORS has no wildcard; Web cookie writes require CSRF and trusted Origin/Referer while native transport requires trusted device context and secure storage.

RS256/JWKS issuer, audience, time, type and scope prechecks are explicit without replacing service PEP; named route classes fail closed on rate-backend uncertainty, 429 carries Retry-After, and canonical errors plus requestId/traceId propagation are frozen.
Boundary audit fields are allow-listed and sensitive credentials and payloads are redacted; external direct service access and unknown versions or routes default to DENY.

Twenty-one OpenAPI and fourteen event fragments merge without drift; five generated files are current; 377 operations, 536 schemas and 154 events validate; both TypeScript packages typecheck; OpenAPI, event and JSON Schema comparison against e5110f2 reports zero breaking changes.

Gateway audit passes; 15/15 failure-closed mutations, P1R 72/72, B7 28/28, B8 29/29 and G1 6/6 pass; independent reviewer m1_003_final_review accepted e4618b324e5a93926da0750a8100fc9377ac97ec using gpt-5.6-luna Max for the D2 scope only.
